title: Do you challenge yourself?
html:
Someone once said “Challenges make you discover things about yourself that you never really knew. They're what make the instrument stretch - what make you go beyond the norm.”

A family friend really challenged herself last week, and stretched herself well beyond the norm, by completing the Badwater Ultramarathon. This isn't the first Ultramarathon Lisa has completed but it is one of hardest as the temperatures are the most extreme, from the sweltering heat during the day to the freezing temperatures at night.

This week you're reading this thinking about the week ahead. Lisa stood there thinking, ‘I have 217 km to go.’

How does Lisa do it? One step at a time. With good planning, good crew and the support of her family, friends and her hometown, New Plymouth. Lisa achieved an amazing test of endurance that had her questioning herself and why she was here and she went through every other emotion you can think off.

Lisa's feat crystallised for me that if you have a challenge that you believe you can do, and you get people on board with you, you can do anything. ANYTHING!

You can do anything when you have to and yet we will quite happily do nothing if we don't have to. Go beyond the norm in something this week and stretch yourself. It will be worth it.
